limits: Fixed-seed bytewise equality is required for controlled one-worker Main cases only.
Unfixed TickCount seeds can change when execution timing changes.
Two-worker equality is covered only by the independent start-coordinate component fixture.
The lookup benchmark includes prefix construction but excludes dispersion, full initialization, meteorology and I/O.
No end-to-end or production-domain speedup claim.
Thirty seconds per synthetic weather situation, not one hour despite hourly labels.
Emission rates vary between transient situations; the existing allocator does not reassign source particle counts each situation.
Valid source count arrays are nonnegative; invalid negative count input is outside this patch.
